---
title: BigPicture Changelog 2026-12-07
sidebar: false
toc: false
---


- Release of metadata-submitter for use by submitters
  - In 2027-02, the current submission processes will be deprecated and will be replaced solely by the use of the metadata-submitter, until then the two processes will operate in parallel.
- Release of the download UI
  - Available at https://download-ui.bp.nbis.se/
- Add deployment of Dataset On Demand Backend service for pilot testing
- Enable additional operational observability features
- Prepare download-v1 for deprecation by updating the download URLs
  - Move "download v1" URL from `https://download.bp.nbis.se` to `https://download-v1.bp.nbis.se`
  - Move "download v2" URL from `https://download-v2.bp.nbis.se` to `https://download.bp.nbis.se`
